muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /d/{datastar} Get(ctx, datastar)" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
{{- define "GET /s/{signals} Show(ctx, signals)" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

// Server has parameters named datastar and signals outside the reserved
// wrapper/argument positions; on unframed routes they stay ordinary path
// values.
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Get(_ context.Context, datastar string) (string, error) { return datastar, nil }

func (Server) Show(_ context.Context, signals string) (string, error) { return signals, nil }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	for path, want := range map[string]string{"/d/x": "<p>x</p>", "/s/y": "<p>y</p>"} {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want %q", path, rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	}
}
